name: Love is Strange
source:
A fan visual novel based off the January 2015 game by Dontnod Entertainment, [url=http://lifeisstrange.com/]Life Is Strange[/url].

The visual novel follows the story of Max Caulfield in her second year at Blackwell Academy. She’s spent the last year reuniting with her best friend, Chloe Price, and meeting and getting to know the other students of Blackwell, like Kate Marsh, Rachel Amber, and Victoria Chase.

Love is Strange is set in a normal alternate universe, and Max does not possess any time powers whatsoever (and Rachel Amber is very much alive). There’s also no secret conspiracies and hidden bunkers; this AU is completely normal and peaceful, and through your choices, a happy one. The game hopes to capture a sense of growing adolescence and love, built by bonds through time and moments of compassion.

[Edited from [url=http://loveisstrange-vn.tumblr.com/about]official website[/url]]
translation:
一部基于Dontnod Entertainment于2015年1月推出的游戏[url=http://lifeisstrange.com/]《奇异人生》[/url]创作的同人视觉小说。

故事讲述麦克斯·考菲尔德在黑威尔学院二年级的生活。过去一年，她与最好的朋友克洛伊·普莱斯重聚，并结识、了解了黑威尔的其他学生，例如凯特·马什、瑞秋·安布尔和维多利亚·蔡斯。

《Love is Strange》设定在普通的平行宇宙中，麦克斯完全没有时间能力（瑞秋·安布尔也仍然活着）。这里没有秘密阴谋或隐藏地堡；这个平行宇宙完全正常而和平，而且通过你的选择，也能迎来幸福。游戏希望捕捉青春成长与爱情的感觉，感情由时间与温柔时刻建立的羁绊孕育。

[改编自[url=http://loveisstrange-vn.tumblr.com/about]官方网站[/url]]
